quirks.condition: A G choosing between ready jobs of equal effective priority when at least one of them has been invalidated by F.
quirks.effect: Invalidation replaces the job's ordering key with a value below every definition-order key, most recent invalidation lowest, so the most recently invalidated job runs first and any invalidated job runs ahead of a never-invalidated job of the same priority.

quirks.condition: A job awaiting rerun after F that has been invalidated two or more times in the session.
quirks.effect: Its effective priority on that rerun is its defined priority minus 7 for each invalidation beyond the first, floored at 1.

quirks.condition: A job being scheduled for the first time (not awaiting a rerun) whose defined priority is a multiple of 10 and which has two or more distinct dependencies.
quirks.effect: Its effective priority is the defined priority plus 1; the increment does not apply when the job is rerun after F.

quirks.condition: At the end of any G, a job not yet executed that names a dependency not defined in the session so far.
quirks.effect: The job is flagged and never scheduled by any later G, even after the dependency is defined and executed; it continues to be counted in GEND's blocked figure.

quirks.condition: A J command whose dependency list repeats an id (compared after case folding).
quirks.effect: The repeats are collapsed to one entry and the job is accepted; the collapsed count is what the fan-in rule sees.

quirks.condition: A job id or dependency reference that differs only in letter case from a job already defined.
quirks.effect: It refers to the same job; output lines echo the first-seen spelling, and redefining under a different case is rejected DUP echoing that spelling.

quirks.condition: A J, F, or G command carrying more tokens than documented.
quirks.effect: The extra tokens are ignored, the dependency list being exactly the fourth whitespace token of J; FMT rejects echo the job token, or ???????? when it is missing or malformed.

unmapped_families.reason: Two mixed 150+ command corpora exercising every quirk above together with the documented behaviour; no single quirk maps.

reader_questions.question: Job A1 is defined with priority 50 and no dependencies. Then: G, F A1, G, F A1. Then job B1 is defined with priority 48 and no dependencies, and G runs. Which job does the first E line of that final G name?
reader_questions.verification:
printf 'J A1 50 0
G
F A1
G
F A1
J B1 48 0
G
' | .venv/bin/python builder/gold_schedcore.py -> ... OK 1 / OK 2 / E B1 / E A1 / GEND 2 0 / X 2 4 2 0

reader_questions.question: Job A1 is defined with priority 50 depending on B1, which is not yet defined. G runs. Then B1 is defined with priority 60 and no dependencies, and G runs twice more. What blocked count does the last GEND line carry?
reader_questions.verification:
printf 'J A1 50 B1
G
J B1 60 0
G
G
' | .venv/bin/python builder/gold_schedcore.py -> OK 1 / GEND 0 1 / OK 2 / E B1 / GEND 1 1 / GEND 0 1 / X 2 1 0 0
